standard: Five years for ordinary information after expiry or termination; trade secrets protected while qualifying under applicable law.
fallback: Three years after expiry or termination for ordinary information, with Legal approval; preserve the trade-secret distinction.
escalate_owner: No survival, rolling short expiry, or a finite trade-secret cutoff. Legal + IP owner. Five years is a policy assumption, not a statutory term.

standard: Use only to evaluate the stated project. No shared-model training or unrelated commercial use.
fallback: Clarify purpose and permitted systems. Broader use needs Legal review; no training permission implied.
escalate_owner: Broader internal-business or commercialization use: YELLOW Legal review. Shared-model training or personal data: RED specialist hold; any RED trigger prevails.

standard: No residuals or unrestricted remembered-information exception.
fallback: Propose deletion or narrowing; any surviving residuals right remains RED. The counterproposal is not acceptance authority.
escalate_owner: Any residuals right: immediate RED Legal + IP hold, including narrowed wording. Do not wait for insistence; no automatic acceptance.

standard: Need-to-know access, equivalent confidentiality obligations, and recipient responsibility for representatives.
fallback: Legal may approve a defined professional-duty carveout for independent advisers, without open-ended onward disclosure.
escalate_owner: Unrestricted affiliates or financing sources, or a blanket responsibility disclaimer. Legal + business owner.

standard: Only disclosure legally required; advance notice and cooperation to the extent lawful.
fallback: Notice as soon as legally permitted; reasonable assistance at the discloser's expense if agreed.
escalate_owner: An unlawful notice duty or disclosure of more than required. Legal; route any actual order to litigation counsel.

standard: Return or destroy within 30 days of request or end; confirm completion if requested.
fallback: Limited legal retention and inaccessible routine backups, continuing confidentiality, no active use; Legal validates feasibility.
escalate_owner: Indefinite convenience retention, re-use, or training after exit. Legal + IT; Privacy if personal data is involved.

standard: Mutual routine evaluation only; verified entities, no extra commercial obligations, documented signature authority.
fallback: Correct entity details and schedules before release. Modified paper goes to client Legal.
escalate_owner: Exclusivity, noncompete, express unlimited liability, export/sanctions alerts or controlled technology: RED specialist hold.
